race.comment: ELLIS BEACH (2) has been racing well with 3 wins from 7 appearances this prep, he cops a wide gate, and 2 more kilos for this, but he remains in the same grade, and he can repeat the dose. TALONS (10) was not far away when finishing fifth over 1300m here last time, beaten only 2.5 lengths, and he gets another chance to upgrade his modest stats over this trip. Each way value. INTRUDER (7) has been racing consistently this prep with 3 placings from 6 starts, and he continues to hold his form well. Expect him to be right in the finish again. LONE FORCE (8) has attracted support at his past couple of outings but hasn't quite delivered. However, he has a good gate, and will take some pegging back from the pole position. BLUEBIRD BAY (6) found 1400m a tad too short 9-days ago at Cairns. The extra 209m will make all the difference, and he can bounce straight back into the money here.
